newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent quoted down, bracing for downside test.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent quoted down, bracing for downside test.

text.p: Brent crude futures were indicated Friday on the low side of London's day-earlier settlement, with players bracing for a test of support on April at $20.00 per barrel.
April Brent was untraded but quoted at $20.00/$20.08 after London closed down 55 cents at $20.08 and just one cent above the intraday low, which was also a six-month low.
Brokers said $20.00 represents a major area of support for the market and a break would indicate minor support at $19.87 but could prices as much as $1.00 lower short term.
NYMEX crude maintained the downward pressure with April, trading on ACCESS, last traded at $21.60, down nine cents from New York.
Brokers said EIA data on Thursday added to the bearish pall. API data showed a crude build of 3.12 million barrels but the EIA showed a larger 4.4 million-barrel build.
